footer.about: Evolve Exteriors is a locally owned and operated exterior remodeling company with hubs in Wichita and Oklahoma City. We replace windows, install vinyl siding and hang sliding patio doors.
why: Manufacturer's lifetime warranty on energy efficient windows
We beat a lower price on a comparable product
Your customers love you: you hold a 5.0 on 140 Google reviews. Your website hides every one of them, and its phone buttons dial a number that does not exist.
So we rebuilt it around what your customers already say: fast crews, clean job sites, owners who answer, and rooms that get quieter and cooler.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Exterior Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page of the demo: what costs you calls today, and how the demo fixes it.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The first page people see, and the one Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: Every call button dials 1234567890, so someone on a phone cannot reach you. Your real numbers sit at the very bottom of the page.
The top of the page says "Best Professional Window Installation" with no town, so Google can't tell you serve Wichita.
The one customer quote is "Samantha Johnson", leftover sample text, while 140 real reviews go unused.
fixes: Every number is a one-tap call, including Oklahoma City.
A headline that says exterior remodeling company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Real reviews from your customers, each beside the point it proves.
cards.alsoAdd: Hourly speed monitoring that keeps your site fast for visitors on phones, and speed is something Google uses to rank you.

cards.title: Window Replacement
cards.why: Windows are about three quarters of your written reviews, and they have no page of their own.
problems: Window styles are a bare list of names on "Our Windows", with nothing on price, warranty or how a job goes.
The "Read More" button on Sliding Patio Doors opens this windows page instead of a patio door page.
fixes: A full page for window replacement in Wichita, KS.
Styles, warranty, price match and install day explained.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Siding & Patio Doors
cards.why: Siding and patio doors are real jobs your crews finish in a day, and your site has no page for either.
problems: "Vinyl Siding" opens a page called "copy-of-our-windows", a leftover duplicate with one paragraph.
Patio doors have no page at all, so nobody searching for one finds you.
fixes: A page for vinyl siding and sliding patio doors in Wichita.
Real jobs and reviews, one for each service.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn't think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: The page where interest turns into a call, and where two offices need clear numbers.
problems: The email link opens info@mysite.com, not your address.
The Oklahoma City number is plain text, and "Get a Free Estimate", "Services" and "About Us" all link back to the homepage.
fixes: Both numbers are one tap, with the hours beside them.
A real contact page that says what to have ready.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

strategy.reportCardHeading: What great exterior company websites get right, and how yours measures up.

reportCard.label: Headline says what you do and where
Each money service has its own page

closing.heading: Want a website like this for your business?
closing.text: Your customers already say you show up, work fast and leave the house clean. You likely do more than we found, so on your onboarding call we confirm the full list of services and every detail with you and your team.

onboardingQuestions: Colton's and Riley's surnames, and how they want to be introduced on the site (the Thumbtack name "Helton" is unconfirmed).
Which phone number should lead on the site for Oklahoma City customers, and do they want the OKC number shown in the header as well as the footer and contact page?

Is there a street address to show? Only an unopened Angi snippet gives 2733 E. Kite Ct., Wichita; the Google profile shows 7804 E Funston St #208, Wichita. Which is current, and is there an OKC address?

Full list of services: entry doors, egress windows, basement windows beyond two reviews, bay and picture windows, soffit and fascia (one owner reply and a few reviews). Triple-pane windows (the blog and one review mention them)?
Window brand they install. "Wallside's Awning Windows" is the only name on the site and we could not confirm a dealer relationship, so no brand is named.
Does the manufacturer's lifetime warranty transfer to the next owner, and are the windows made in the USA? Only one review says so.
Years in business: the site says 5+ years in the industry, reviews start March 2025. What can we say?
Licensing, insurance, BBB or any certification to verify and show. None is stated anywhere we found.
Is financing through a named lender, and may we say "low-to-no interest"? The financing page also names the wrong city (Addison).
Should the 15% off sign-up offer on the current homepage be honored on the new site?
Typical install times for windows and siding, and what is included in the window and siding consultations, so the steps can be firmed up.
Logo file and brand colors (not sampled; none held in our files).
Is Evolve Egress and Exteriors (named in one review and on Angi) the same company?
